author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for PUNK, an open-world bullet hell action roguelike developed by Balazs Sabransky and Balazs Maczak. Fight vicious creatures, explore diverse biomes, hone your movement skills, manage resources, tinker with weapons and gadgets to upgrade your tiny ship until you become the apex predator of this strange, alien world. PUNK is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: PUNK - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the launch trailer for Smile More, a short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace! Smile More is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Smile More - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: You awaken in a strange, abandoned research station. Disoriented and alone, clutching a handful of mysterious crimson coins. But you're not truly alone... Something lurks in the shadows, watching your every move. Solace Creek is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Solace Creek - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for True Confession, a criminal top-down shooter developed by Gv0_ink. The story follows Henry, who is tormented by nightmares in which he dreams of gunfights and murders. Henry is a religious man, and he is frightened by the attraction of anger and hatred that he experiences in his dreams. Players will live in Henry's subconscious, in his ruthless dreams, and will play in those images, learning more about his life story and the images from his past. True Confession is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: True Confession - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Casse-Croute Deckbuilder, a roguelike deckbuilder where food is your weapon. Instead of controlling the hero directly, you manage their meals. Each dish you prepare grants effects that influence combat, allowing you to build powerful strategies through food and kitchen tools. Position, timing, and pathing matter. Move across the board to play cards, chain effects, and create broken combos. Manage your Appetite wisely to keep playing cards, but be careful — too much Cholesterol can backfire. Every run offers new cards, tools, and synergies to discover, making each attempt a fresh tactical challenge. Casse-Croute Deckbuilder is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
A feeling of being safer than one really is...
Take a look at the teaser for the long-awaited sequel for Alien: Isolation, the survival horror game developed by Creative Assembly.
title: Alien: Isolation - Official Sequel Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Loya announcement trailer for this upcoming open-world, survival RPG. Command walking fortresses to battle giant monsters. Play alone or bring your friends to explore, farm, fight, build and craft to unravel the mysteries of Loya! Loya will be available on PC.
title: Loya - Official Announcement Trailer
